title: Tools
description: Use splectrum tool wrappers instead of raw commands. Enables auditing and consistency.

sections.name: Principle
sections.description: Always use spl tools/X instead of raw X. Splectrum wrappers pass through to the underlying tool but enable auditing, logging, and platform integration.

sections.name: Base64 Encoding
sections.description: Use base64= prefix to bypass shell escaping for special characters (!, quotes, etc.).

sections.name: Coming
sections.description: More wrappers will be added for commonly used tools
